articles.title: New guide helps Alaskans shape data center conversations
articles.summary: As data centers and artificial intelligence raise new questions about energy, water, land, infrastructure, jobs and community priorities across Alaska, a new report from the University of Alaska Fairbanks offers a different way to approach the conversation. “Computing in Place: A Conversation Guide on Data Centers for Alaskans, by Alaskans” was developed by the Alaska Center […]
